text: Trap bar 4x4 @ 2 RIR on 2026-11-23 was prescribed at 235 lb (inverse Epley from the baseline 235x5 treated as 0 RIR, 229 lb rounded UP to the plate step); felt too heavy, coached down to 215-225 lb mid-session. Hevy showed decimal weights (e.g. 235.01, 89.95 lb) because push sends kg rounded to 0.1; warm-up 117.5 lb is a half-plate number. Candidate code fixes (need athlete OK): send exact lb-derived kg, round hinge loads down, warm-up ramps to whole plates.
